consensus: Both eligible peers must make the same non-neutral call; disagreement or missing evidence abstains
overlap_filter: Each peer must overlap at least 50 percent of MUSA calendar quarter; same threshold as existing overlap diagnostics
strength_filter: Each peer absolute own-baseline surprise must be at least 2 cents per gallon; illustrative threshold frozen before this experiment, not optimized
comparisons: Each individual peer and constant direction on identical called rows; coverage and abstained-row outcomes reported
company_specific_effects: No new acquisition or accounting exclusions inferred from outcomes; incompatible peer definitions remain a limitation
selection: No best variant selected for deployment; no threshold search; existing history already researched
